identity.title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL

problem.claim: Multi-turn RL training for LLM agents is unstable, with reasoning quality affecting task performance.

gap.claim: Entropy and existing metrics can miss input-agnostic reasoning that remains internally diverse or entropy-stable.

contributions.claim: Identifies template collapse, where stable entropy coexists with input-agnostic boilerplate, and proposes an online mutual-information proxy for cross-input distinguishability.
Attributes collapse to an SNR mechanism in which low within-input reward variance weakens task gradients, allowing input-agnostic regularization to dominate.
Introduces SNR-Aware Filtering, which prioritizes high-variance prompts during each training iteration.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors distinguish template collapse from entropy-detectable instability and introduce MI-based online diagnosis with SNR-Aware Filtering as a mitigation.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that, across tasks, their MI proxy correlates with final performance much more strongly than entropy.
The authors report consistent improvements in input dependence and task performance across planning, math reasoning, web navigation, and code execution.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper frames multi-turn agent RL as unstable and links reasoning quality to task performance.
It argues that entropy monitors within-input diversity but not dependence on the input.
It names template collapse, proposes an MI proxy, and explains the phenomenon through an SNR mechanism.
It applies SNR-Aware Filtering and reports improvements across four task categories.

source_observation.claim: The abstract separates within-input diversity from cross-input distinguishability and aligns its proposed MI proxy with the latter.

lessons.interpretation: A metric is more informative when it measures the behavioral property tied to the claimed failure mode, rather than a convenient proxy.
lessons.application: Define the failure mode operationally first, then add a monitoring metric that directly tests the missing property alongside the standard metric.
lessons.exception: This move is unsuitable when the target property cannot be measured online or when the proxy lacks a demonstrated relationship to the downstream objective.

unknowns: No quantitative correlation values, improvement magnitudes, task sizes, baselines, or statistical conditions are provided.
The abstract does not specify the MI proxy formulation, filtering threshold, or whether reported gains isolate filtering from the diagnostic and SNR explanation.
